inputs.text: [happily] Ready to travel back in time, Wex? [pauses] Let's start [excited] at the very beginning...
[chuckles] Oh yes! [happily] Way, way before! [serious] Right at the start, almost four billion years ago. [pauses] The Earth is hot and empty. [serious] No animals. No plants. Nothing at all.
[curious][pauses] Then, in the water, [softly] a tiny, [happily] a teeny-tiny bacteria appears.
[playful] Then? [quickly] Algae, [gasps] little fish, [excited] then worms, coral, jellyfish, tiny shelled creatures.
[curious] And all that only lives in the water?
[happily] Yes! [serious] There's still no life on dry land at all. [excited] Then one animal crawls out of the water: a big lizard with four legs.
[curious] What about plants? Do they come out of the water too?

[happily] Yes, around the same time! [softly] Simple little mosses, then ferns. They grow on dry land, [happily] and it turns green. [gasps] So the four-legged animals have something to eat, [excited] and they move in!
[playful] Of course! [pauses] In the water, big fish ate little fish. [excited] And on land, big lizards ate little insects. [serious] There have always been carnivores and herbivores.
[happily] Next, we jump forward in time. [excited] Millions of years go by. [gasps] And then… [chuckles] want to hear what happens next?
